name: Arjun Nair
headline: Lead Data Engineer
summary: Big-data engineer with 8 years building PySpark and streaming platforms on AWS for media and fintech. I care about cost per terabyte as much as pipeline latency.

experience.title: Lead Data Engineer
bullets: Lead six engineers running the viewing-events platform: Kafka streams of 1.5 billion events a day landing in an AWS lake.
Rewrote the nightly recommendations feature build in PySpark on EMR, cutting runtime from 7 hours to 80 minutes and cost by 45%.
Standardised 200 Airflow DAGs on a shared Docker image with lineage and data-quality checks.
Own the SQL semantic layer that content and ad-sales analysts query every day.

experience.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Built PySpark pipelines for loan, repayment and bureau data feeding the risk models.
Introduced Airflow to replace 70 cron jobs and added SLA alerts for regulatory reports.
Wrote incremental SQL loads into the AWS warehouse and versioned every pipeline in Git.
